description: This file implements memory-mapped register access functions for the B53 device driver, including read and write operations of various widths, and includes driver initialization and removal code using the Linux platform driver framework.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from the memory-mapped register at given page and register offset.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value, considering endianness, from the specified register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value, considering endianness, from the specified register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value spread over multiple registers.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from two 32-bit registers.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the specified register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value, considering endianness, to the specified register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value, considering endianness, to the specified register.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value spread over multiple registers.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value using two 32-bit register accesses.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_probe(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Initializes the device upon probe, sets up switch configuration.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_remove(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Removes the device when the driver is unloaded.
